details.description: A tender slice of the delicious mango that has soaked in the essential flavours of chillies and other spices to give you an irresistible taste. Mango pickle is a mixture of juicy green mangoes with authentic spices. It is arranged from mango and extra spices. This raw mango delight is completed for anyone and everyone who is mad about mangoes. It can be had anytime, wherever and with everything. It is a wonderful pickle to enjoy with your family.
details.ingredients: Mango (55%), Salt, Refined Rice Bran Oil, Mixed Spice Powder, Acitic Acid (INS 260), CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE (INS 211)
